answer: Sybil resistance follows from reputation with exponential temporal decay: each node’s contribution loses half its weight every fixed half-life, so credibility requires sustained honest service rather than a one-time burst. In EigenTrust factorization, a freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming support; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap it through colluding peers. Thus even an opal, lotus, or sonnet-themed alias cannot pass consensus without durable, cross-linked evidence.
